prompts.costume: astronaut with a round space helmet and a small star badge
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One original counting-costume coloring-book sticker: the numeral "1" itself is the character's body, dressed as a astronaut with a round space helmet and a small star badge. The numeral must remain immediately legible with its correct silhouette and holes; costume accessories must not hide the numeral.  Friendly tiny dot eyes and a smile, little mitten hands and rounded shoes. Simple flat front view. NOT made of cubes or stacked blocks; no television character styling, logos, existing character costume or branding. Entire isolated figure including accessories, centered with wide transparent margin. Bold clean black closed outlines on opaque pure white interiors, transparent exterior, NO shading, no gray, no hatching or filled black clothing. Large open coloring regions, restrained details. Consistent outline weight about 16 pixels at 1024px source height, intended to become 5 pixels at a 320px sticker height. No other characters, background, ground, captions or text except the numeral body.
